crossRefs.note: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron…

parallels.note: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
